# Scope: country
bag_wtp_register_zone_list = {
	cmm_register_settings_list = {
		mod_id = bag_wtp
		setting_id = continent
		tab_id = zone
		item_count = 5
		is_ordered = 0
	}

	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = continent item = 1 value = continent:europe }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = continent item = 2 value = continent:asia }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = continent item = 3 value = continent:africa }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = continent item = 4 value = continent:america }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = continent item = 5 value = continent:oceania }

	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__continent_i1_name value = flag:europe }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__continent_i2_name value = flag:asia }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__continent_i3_name value = flag:africa }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__continent_i4_name value = flag:america }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__continent_i5_name value = flag:oceania }

	cmm_register_list_bool_field = {
		mod_id = bag_wtp
		setting_id = continent
		field_id = pick
		default_value = 0
	}
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_rebuild_zone = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_continents
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_zone_count value = 0 }

	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__continent }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__continent field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_ticks }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_ticks
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_zone_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Every land location of the ticked continents, for when the player ranks a whole
# continent without narrowing it first.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_collect_zone = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_continents
		every_location_in_continent = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_is_candidate = yes }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_candidates target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_candidate_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
}
#
# «Сбросить пометки город/село», по всему миру.
#
# The tick is a location variable and it outlives a save, so a reset that
# covered only what is on screen would leave the same trap it exists to remove:
# 2026-09-02 he cleared the fourteen he could see, widened the ground, and the
# fourteen he could not came into the plan looking exactly like a revert.
#
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_clear_ticks = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tick_count value = 0 }
	continent:europe = {
		every_location_in_continent = {
			limit = { OR = {
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural
			} }
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tick_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
	continent:asia = {
		every_location_in_continent = {
			limit = { OR = {
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural
			} }
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tick_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
	continent:africa = {
		every_location_in_continent = {
			limit = { OR = {
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural
			} }
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_town

		}
	}
	continent:america = {
		every_location_in_continent = {
			limit = { OR = {
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural

			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural

		}
	}

				has_variable = bag_wtp_force_rural

			remove_variable = bag_wtp_force_town
